control_flow: stopAtWall: if the RIGHT obstacle sensor sees a wall, turn right 90°; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Stop before the wall and stay there.

decision_points.condition: the obstacle sensor RIGHT sees a wall

branches.outcome: a wall is seen: it turns right 90°
no wall is seen: it follows the line

equivalence_classes: a wall straight ahead, so the right sensor sees it

scenarios.coded_response: It turns right 90° at 30 % instead of stopping.

scenarios.trigger: The RIGHT obstacle sensor sees the wall.
scenarios.title: Stops at the wall
assumptions: The wall is straight ahead, so the right sensor sees it.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It stops before the wall without bumping into it, and stays there.

scenarios.coded_response: It curves left on black and right on the floor, again and again.

tests.name: Stops before the wall on the line

expected_results: The robot stays still in front of the wall and does not drive on.

postconditions.description: During the whole run, the robot never bumps into the wall.
Whenever the wall is ahead for a moment, the robot stands still.
From 1 s on, the robot stands still to the end of the run.

assumptions: The wall stands straight ahead of the robot, so its right obstacle sensor sees it.
